items.title: Wendell Harrison interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, November 10, 2022 [interview 1 of 2]
items.q: He was playing “’Round About Midnight” he was playing “Shiny Stockings” or Hoagy Carmichael, “Stardust.”

ctx.x: Yeah. And you think well Miles can do that.

Yeah. Well and it reinforces his identity and his approach. You know he does that, Miles. So as soon as somebody else plays the same way he said, “Well he’s copying Miles” or “he’s playing Miles.” You know? Same with Trane, the different ideas Trane had. You know sometimes Trane would play — Trane made four or five different transitions in his playing. I was studying Sonny Rollins and then I started listening to Trane when I was 17, 18 years old, in Detroit you know. And I was copying these ideas. “Trane did this…
